title: HotbarDropLock
description: Prevents accidental hotbar drops unless sneaking.
body:
# HotbarDropLock

Prevents accidental hotbar drops unless sneaking.

## Features
- Blocks item drops when not sneaking.
- Optional message cooldown to reduce spam.
- Configurable requirement to sneak.
- Lightweight drop hook.

## Command
- `/hotbardrop status | /hotbardrop reload`

## Permissions
- `hotbardroplock.use`
- `hotbardroplock.admin`

## Config (snippet)
```yml
require-sneak: true
message-cooldown-seconds: 2
```

## Compatibility
- Server: Paper, Spigot, Purpur
- Minecraft: 1.16.5 - 1.21.4

## Install
1. Drop the jar into `plugins/`.
2. Restart the server.
3. Edit `config.yml` and run the reload command.
